summary.name: Snapzy
summary.one_liner: Snapzy is a free, open-source native macOS app for screenshots, screen recording, annotation, and video/GIF editing.
use_cases: capturing scrolling webpages or long documents
annotating screenshots with arrows and numbered steps
recording screen with system audio and microphone
extracting text from images or video frames
trimming and exporting screen recordings to GIF
summary.what_it_does: Snapzy captures screen areas, individual windows, full displays, and scrolling content, with a smart mode that snaps to UI elements and a delay timer for hover states. After a capture, a floating preview lets you drag, copy, save, or edit it. The built-in editor adds arrows, text, shapes, highlights, blur, and step numbering, and the video editor trims, crops, changes speed, adds padding, and exports MP4 or GIF. It also records screen video with system audio and microphone, runs on-device OCR to copy text to the clipboard, and keeps a searchable capture history.
notable: Free and open-source, notarized by Apple, with a voluntary Supporter donation option
Fully on-device OCR and zero telemetry, per the page
Smart Capture auto-detects UI elements like buttons, cards, and menus to snap to
